title: CISA Admin Leaked AWS GovCloud Keys on Github
summary: Until this past weekend, a contractor for the Cybersecurity & Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) maintained a public GitHub repository that exposed credentials to several highly privileged AWS GovCloud accounts and a large number of internal CISA systems. summary_short: CISA contractor leaked AWS GovCloud keys on GitHub, exposing internal systems.

title: On AI Security
summary: Good report: Executive Summary: Let’s say you wanted to make sure that your AI is secure. Can you just maximize the security and privacy benchmark and call it a day?
